name: leeching_sliver_each_attacking_sliver
notes: B-103 (2026-11-06, the fresh-eyes review of engine/atoms-wave2; fixed by the once_per_event axis). Printed: 'Whenever a Sliver you control attacks, defending player loses 1 life.' Two Slivers attack: each Sliver's ability triggers once per attacking Sliver (CR 508.3a, 603.2c), four triggers, so seat 1 loses 4 plus 2 combat damage (14). Before the fix the binder queued one instance per ability per declaration, so seat 1 ended at 16. The one-Sliver pack defending_player_leeching_sliver pins the defending player.
